testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect sketch parameter search criteria: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:322:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect sketch parameter search criteria ✔ Given a part is open in the MCAD Software with its model browser visible ✔ When the user chooses Find from the model browser menu ✔ And the user chooses Sketches in the object type list ✔ And the user opens the Property list ✔ Then the list offers Name, Note contents, Note title and Sketch Parameter Name ✔ When the user chooses Sketch Parameter Name ✔ Then the Condition field displays contains ✔ And the Value field is empty and adds to list is disabled ✔ When the user opens the Condition list ✔ Then it offers contains and does not contain ✔ When the user dismisses the list and closes the dialog ✔ Then the model browser and part are visible
